description: This file defines the Coupon class in the Opencart admin marketing controller namespace. It manages the CRUD operations, listing, form handling, and pagination for coupons in the OpenCart admin panel.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketing coupons in the OpenCart admin panel, providing functionalities for listing, creating, editing, and deleting coupons.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for the coupon controller, loads language, sets title, handles request parameters, generates breadcrumbs, and displays the coupons list.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the display of the coupon list by calling getList() and setting the response output.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the coupon list with filtering, sorting, pagination, and data retrieval from the model.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares the data necessary for the coupon creation/edit form, including coupon details, associated products, and form actions.
